protocol.scope: K: instruction-size assistance; not motor skill transfer
protocol.normalization: train only; same paired scenes and pixels/actions; language differs
protocol.checkpoint: final at prescribed update, not selected by test success
protocol.failures: preserve all captures and technical failures; stop on technical error
protocol.costs: all generation attempts, six extra technical pairs, trainer probe and two full jobs counted separately
protocol.change_from_v3: v3 model: 0/20, jaws closed 5 cm from the object; the aligned start pose (wrist pitch 25) showed the object in the arm camera in 0/30 scenes. v4 starts at wrist pitch -15 (object visible 30/30). Everything else unchanged; v3 results kept.
